title: Brain Intro
summary: A calibration pack for the first JJU visual recall game loop.

automation.modelPlan: Local vision/LLM candidates feed a review queue before a pack can ship.

stages.label: Pull candidate diagrams
stages.detail: Find open diagrams or original schematics and attach source/license metadata.

stages.label: Suggest targets
stages.detail: Use a local model to propose labels, dots, polygons, and confidence scores.

stages.label: Compress facts
stages.detail: Generate short functional prompts, aliases, and parent-child relationships.

stages.label: Human approve/fix
stages.detail: Approve only the labels and targets that survive manual review.

stages.label: Publish pack
stages.detail: Blocked until targets, facts, and license ledger are clean.

assetLedger.notes: Hand-seeded calibration diagram for proving the interaction loop.

targets.label: Frontal lobe
functions: Plans goals and controls executive decisions
Starts voluntary movement through motor cortex
Supports inhibition, judgment, and personality

targets.label: Parietal lobe
functions: Maps touch, pressure, pain, and body position
Supports spatial attention and body awareness
Helps track where objects are in space

targets.label: Occipital lobe
functions: Processes visual input from the eyes
Builds edges, motion, color, and shape into sight
Primary cortical hub for vision

targets.label: Temporal lobe
functions: Processes sound and speech input
Supports language comprehension
Links hearing, memory, and object recognition

targets.label: Cerebellum
functions: Coordinates smooth, accurate movement
Maintains balance and posture
Corrects timing errors while moving

targets.label: Brainstem
functions: Carries signals between brain and spinal cord
Controls basic survival functions like breathing and heart rate
Houses cranial nerve pathways and arousal systems

targets.label: Midbrain
functions: Controls eye movement and visual orienting reflexes
Routes movement signals through dopamine circuits
Handles quick visual and auditory orienting

targets.label: Pons
functions: Relay bridge between cortex and cerebellum for coordination
Helps regulate breathing rhythm and sleep
Carries face movement and sensation pathways

targets.label: Medulla
functions: Regulates heart rate, breathing, and blood pressure
Controls swallowing, coughing, vomiting, and other reflexes
Lowest brainstem gateway to the spinal cord

targets.label: Corpus callosum
functions: Connects the left and right cerebral hemispheres
Lets both sides of the cortex share information
Largest white matter bridge in the brain

targets.label: Thalamus
functions: Relays most sensory signals to the cortex
Helps regulate attention and consciousness
Routes incoming information to the right cortical areas

targets.label: Hypothalamus
functions: Maintains homeostasis for hunger, thirst, and temperature
Controls hormone signaling through the pituitary
Links the nervous system to endocrine control

targets.label: Pituitary gland
functions: Releases hormones under hypothalamus control
Master gland for growth, stress, thyroid, and reproductive signals
Endocrine output hub hanging below the hypothalamus

targets.label: Pineal gland
functions: Releases melatonin for sleep timing
Helps tune circadian rhythm to light and dark
Small endocrine gland near the center of the brain

targets.label: Hippocampus
functions: Builds new declarative memories
Supports spatial memory and navigation maps
Links events with context

targets.label: Amygdala
functions: Tags threats and emotionally important signals
Supports fear learning and emotional memory
Helps decide what sensory input matters
